prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1227; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents with a crushed front bumper cover, a cracked right headlamp assembly, and a bent hood latch support, consistent with a frontal impact during a left turn. Some of the lower radiator support damage may have resulted from this event, though it is not clearly separable from the impact at hand. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the latch support, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours submitted fit the scope of the visible damage, and the parts and charges listed appear once each with no repeated entries. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or the inspection.
